translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: Akt
book.title: Akt Riy ta paliinna ku Iisa Masi

content: Piyer iŋ Yaaya ɗo uŋco ka agindaw ku Yuudinnar
Wiktin taat Piyer iŋ Yaaya kaawiy misa ɗo geemir di, *agindaw ku Yuudinnar daarin̰ astu : gay satkiner, tatkaw ka askirnar kaak gooƴa ger ka Buŋdi, ho iŋ *Sadusiyenna oki.
Min ŋu taliig di, ŋu dapin̰tu asaan Piyer iŋ Yaaya ɓilda gee a Buŋ nooyig Iisa min ɗo muuti. Ansii kat, gee oki asiy nooye.
Hiyya, ŋu obiigu ho ŋu un̰jiig daŋaayne. Ŋu waltu atta asaan pat ɗeete.
Kar gay, min gee kuuk cokiyit kaaw ta paliinnar ɗo *ger ka Buŋdi-ak, dakina aamintu. Iŋ ŋuur kuuk awalle, okin̰co, ŋuu nece ar gee alip beeƴ (5000) pa.
Ka kawtinti, agindaw ku Yuudinnar, man̰jikina ho agindaw ku gaanuundi n̰umtu okin̰co ɗo geeger ka Zeruzaleem.
Ɗo wer-ak, gin gem rakki ŋu kolaag *Han, *mee satkiner ka tatko, iŋ *Kayip, Yaaya, Alekzandir, ho iŋ gee okin̰co ku adiy ka ger ka gay satkiner ka tatko-aka.
Kar Piyer iŋ Yaaya, ŋu imiliig min ɗo daŋaayner ho ŋu iyiig uŋco, ŋu indiigu aman : « Ku cooliig gem-aŋ iŋ gudurre ta waa ho iŋ siŋ ku waa ? »
Min ŋaar-ak di, Buŋ miiniig Piyer iŋ Ruwwiney kar ŋa kaawiico aman : « Kuŋ agindaw ku Yuudinnar ho iŋ ku darrer :
ƴiriyta ku indaani ɗo bi ka a ni ginji sellen̰ ɗo ruŋgiiner-aŋka ho ku raka ibine iŋ maman gem-aŋ cooltu.

Di ŋaar-ak, ya gem-aŋ, ku talaag ŋa pey uŋko cewey-aŋ, kuŋ ibanno yoo gee ku Israyeel okin̰co kadar gem-aŋ gas aapiye iŋ siŋ ku Iisa Masi kaak min Nazareet. Ta barkin tan̰ji kat coolig gem-aŋka. Ŋaar ko ku ɗooɗtu ka etor ho Buŋ gay nooyig min ɗo muuti.
Ɗo bi ka Iisa, ŋu siirtu ɗo Kitamner aman :

content.text: ‟ Ŋa dambi kaak gay pinindi accitu.
Ŋaar ko gin dambi kaak taɓ ka gerdi. ”

content: Ka seener, jile goy iŋ ŋaar di. Min ɗo duniiner okintiti, Buŋ bal diye siŋ ku pey ɗo geemir a ŋuu gase jile, illa siŋ kun̰ji di. »
Ɗo wiktin taar-at, agindaw ku abaadin ta Yuudinnar
ajbiytu tak-tak, asaan ŋu talaag Yaaya iŋ Piyer bal garkiye, kar ŋu kaawaaco ɗo uŋco bal kolaw. Ŋu ibintu kadar ŋu gee kuuk aaɗiig Iisa.
Kar gay, min ŋu taliig gem kaak cool-ak goy uŋco, ŋu ibanno kaaw tak-tak taat ŋuuco telke.
Hiyya, ŋu kaawiico aman : « Amiloŋ kara min anne ! » Min ŋu amiltu, agindaw ku Yuudinnar teestu kaawe benannico ɗo bi kan̰co.
Ŋu kaawtu aman : « Di gee-aŋ gi ginin̰ maman ? Gee okin̰co kuuk goy Zeruzaleem gin kabarre kadar ŋuur ko ginig maan kaak ajbay-aŋka. Iŋ taar-an, gi gediraaɗo gii meele.
Kar gay, gi rakaaɗo kadar kabarre-an yaa totire ɗo geemir. Diŋka-aŋ giico toɗe, ŋu kaawenno bat iŋ siŋ ku Iisa ɗo waanna ho ya ŋu kaawa pey, ŋuu aawe raɗa. »
Min ŋaar-ak, ŋu koliig Piyer iŋ Yaaya ho ŋu ɗiyiico aman : « Yaman kawiyoŋ tak-tak-tak, dakoŋ kaawenno ho dakoŋ ɓildenno pey gee iŋ siŋ ku Iisa. »
Kar ŋuur gay telkiico aman : « Ya loko-ak, taat moo samaane, nii iceŋ kat taat moo, kaawin kuŋkoŋ wala kaaw ta Buŋdi ?
Nin gay bugumaaɗo. Ni kaawin taat ni taltu ho ni dortu min ɗo Iisa. »
Kar agindaw ku Yuudinnar teestu karmin̰co pey, kar ŋu rasiigu asaan ŋu balco gase oorne taat ŋuu obin̰co ho gee okin̰co ozilaag Buŋ ɗo maan kaak kuuniye.
Ŋu oziliiga-ak asaan gem kaak cool-ak ajbiyiig gee-aku, elginay yaa pake orok pooɗ.
Salaan ta gee kuuk aamine
Min agindaw ku Yuudinnar-ak pikiigu, Piyer iŋ Yaaya dakiig gas een̰co ho ŋu osiicog maan kaak agindaw ku gay satkiner ho agindaw ku Yuudinnar kaawiico.

Min ŋu doriit kaawco-at, okin̰co, ŋu teestu salkiye sawa iŋ gelbin rakki. Ɗo salaanco-at ŋu kaawa aman : « *Rabbin Buŋ, ŋa kiŋke-aŋ ko kaak kilgiyig samaane iŋ kiɗa, barre ho iŋ gamin okin̰co kuuk goya.
Ŋa kiŋke-aŋ ko kaak berit Ruwwinen̰ ɗo migini
Dawuud kaak gay riyon̰. Ruwwin-at ko n̰aamig ŋa kaawiy aman : Ŋa dambi kaak gay pinindi accitu,

content.text: ‟ Maa di gee ku duniiner saariy motol ?
Ho agindaw n̰um a ŋuu poocin̰ Rabbine

content: Hii, ka seener, *Herood iŋ Pons Pilaat n̰umtu Zeruzaleem iŋ gee kuuk Yuudinna iŋ kuuk Yuudinnaɗo a ŋuu poocin̰ gay riyon̰ kaak ki doɓtu ho ki darjiytu.
Ampa-ak, ŋu ginit okintit taat ki kaawtu min awalle ho taat ki raktu iŋ gudurren̰.
Kar diŋ gay, Rabbine talu, ŋu saraaninta. Berni gudurren̰ taat ni gaarin kaawon̰ bal kolaw.
Gaar gudurren̰, kii coole gee ho iŋ siŋ ku Iisa, kii gine gamin kuuk gaara gudurren̰ ho kuuk ajbay, ŋaar kaak ki doɓtu ɗo riyon̰. »
Wiktin taat ŋu gaastu iŋ salaane, werco kaak ŋu goyiy-ak teestu azire. Okin̰co, Ruwwin ta Buŋdi miiniigu ho ŋu ɓaawtu gaare kaaw ta Buŋdi bal kolaw.
Gee kuuk aamin ɗeeɗa gaminco benannico
Gee kuuk aamine, okin̰co kaawco rakki ho gelbinco oki rakki. Paa ko, ŋu n̰umiig gaminco okin̰co sawa. Ginno gem kaak yaa kaawe a maanna-aŋ kanto.
Paliinna kaawtu ɗo bi ka Rabbin Iisa aman : « Ŋa nooye ho ni talig iŋ odinni. » Ŋu kaawtu iŋ gudurre okintiti ho iŋ gee ku aamin-ak, okin̰co, Buŋ barkiyiig dakina.
Ɗo ɗatikco, ginno gem kaak arumji maanna. Asaan ay gem kaak gin kiɗa ho gin ger-ak di gidiyiig gamnay ho ŋa iyiig gurusji.
Ŋu beriig ɗo pise ka paliinnar ho ŋuur gay, ɗeeɗiig gurus-ak ɗo ay gemo uudin taat yaaji nece.
Ɗo ɗatikco, gin gem rakki ŋu kolaag Yuusup. Paliinna gay, kolaag pey a ŋa Barnabaas, siŋ-ak kaawa a « Gem kaak iska gee ». Ŋaar min baa tan̰ Lebi, kar ŋu weeyig ɗo kiɗ ka Sipre.
Gem ŋaar-ak gin kiɗa. Ŋa gidiyiiga, kar ŋa iyiig gurus-aka, ŋa beriig ɗo paliinnar.

footnotes.text: Ɗo gaanuun ka Yuudinnar, ŋu ɗukamno seriin iŋ aando.
Wer ka gase kaawor ɗo Soom 118.22.
‛agindaw ku Yuudinnar’ : Gee ŋuur-ak, ŋu orok peesira iŋ rakki gemo. Tatkuwco, ŋaar mee satkiner ka tatko ho riyco gay, ta ɗukume seriiner ta abaadin ta Yuudinnar.
‛migini’ : Werin daarin̰, ŋu kaawa a ‛tanni ka tatko’.
Wer ka gase kaawor ɗo Soom 2.1-2.
